title: "RQ1: Growth Trajectory"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---
```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

nature_colors <- c("#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
                  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9")

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())

dat <- read_csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1"))
  )
```

## Volume Trends
```{r fig-annual-output}
dat |>
  count(year) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(growth = (n / lag(n) - 1) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n), fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = growth * 10), color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = growth * 10), color = "#E85D75", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Publications",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 10, name = "Growth rate (%)")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year")
```
```{r fig-cooperation-type}
dat |>
  drop_na(coop) |>
  count(year, coop) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = coop)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("bilateral" = "#4A90E2", "multilateral" = "#E85D75"),
    labels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of publications", color = NULL)
```
```{r tbl-total-summary}
dat |>
  summarise(
    `Total publications` = n(),
    `Years covered` = paste(min(year), "-", max(year)),
    `Mean per year` = round(n() / n_distinct(year), 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Quality Evolution
```{r fig-quartile-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  count(year, quartile) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = quartile)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Q1" = "#4A90E2", "Q2" = "#95B8A8", 
               "Q3" = "#E8B861", "Q4" = "#E85D75")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of publications", color = "Quartile")
```
```{r fig-q1-proportion}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(q1_pct = 100 * mean(quartile == "Q1")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = q1_pct)) +
  geom_line(color = "#4A90E2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#4A90E2", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#E85D75", 
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Q1 publications (%)")
```
```{r tbl-quality-overall}
dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Q1 (%)` = round(100 * mean(quartile == "Q1"), 1),
    `Q2 (%)` = round(100 * mean(quartile == "Q2"), 1),
    `Q3 (%)` = round(100 * mean(quartile == "Q3"), 1),
    `Q4 (%)` = round(100 * mean(quartile == "Q4"), 1),
    `Mean SJR` = round(mean(sjr_score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `Median citations` = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Disciplinary Composition
```{r fig-macroarea-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  select(year, PS, LS, HS, SS) |>
  pivot_longer(PS:SS, names_to = "domain", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(value == 1) |>
  count(year, domain) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = domain)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("PS" = "#264653", "LS" = "#2A9D8F", 
               "HS" = "#E76F51", "SS" = "#F4A261"),
    labels = c("Physical Sciences", "Life Sciences", 
               "Health Sciences", "Social Sciences")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of publications", fill = NULL)
```
```{r tbl-top-subjects}
subject_cols <- c("med", "agr_bio", "egin", "env_sci", "phys", 
                 "bio_chem", "mat_sci", "chem", "comp_sci", "immu")

subject_labels <- c("Medicine", "Agricultural & Biological Sciences",
                   "Engineering", "Environmental Science", 
                   "Physics & Astronomy", "Biochemistry/Genetics/Molecular Biology",
                   "Materials Science", "Chemistry", "Computer Science",
                   "Immunology & Microbiology")

dat |>
  select(all_of(subject_cols)) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "subject", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(subject = subject_labels) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(`%` = round(100 * n / nrow(dat), 1)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
```{r tbl-macroarea-distribution}
dat |>
  summarise(
    `Physical Sciences` = sum(PS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Life Sciences` = sum(LS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Health Sciences` = sum(HS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Social Sciences` = sum(SS == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Macro-area", values_to = "N") |>
  mutate(`%` = round(100 * N / nrow(dat), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Open Access Adoption
```{r fig-oa-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(oa_rate = 100 * mean(OA == "OA")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = oa_rate)) +
  geom_line(color = "#06A77D", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#06A77D", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Open Access rate (%)")
```
```{r tbl-oa-overall}
dat |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `OA publications` = sum(OA == "OA"),
    `OA rate (%)` = round(100 * mean(OA == "OA"), 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig-oa-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  count(year, OA) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = OA)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("OA" = "#4A90E2", "Not OA" = "#E85D75"),
    labels = c("Open Access", "Not Open Access")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Proportion of publications", fill = NULL)
```

```{r fig-citations-boxplot-by-year}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  mutate(year_group = cut(year, breaks = seq(2000, 2025, 5), 
                          include.lowest = TRUE,
                          labels = c("2000-04", "2005-09", "2010-14", 
                                    "2015-19", "2020-24"))) |>
  filter(!is.na(year_group)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year_group, y = cited, fill = year_group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep(c("#4A90E2", "#95B8A8", "#E8B861", 
                                   "#E85D75", "#CC78BC"), 1)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Period", y = "Citations (log scale)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r fig-subjects-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

subject_cols <- c("med", "agr_bio", "egin", "env_sci", "phys", 
                 "bio_chem", "mat_sci", "chem", "comp_sci", "immu")
subject_labels <- c("Medicine", "Agr & Bio Sci", "Engineering", 
                   "Env Science", "Physics", "Biochem/Genetics",
                   "Materials Sci", "Chemistry", "Computer Sci", 
                   "Immunology")

dat |>
  select(year, all_of(subject_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "subject", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(value == 1) |>
  count(year, subject) |>
  mutate(subject = factor(subject, levels = subject_cols, 
                         labels = subject_labels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = subject, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#E8F4F8", high = "#0173B2", 
                     name = "Publications") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL)
```
```{r fig-coop-by-quartile}
#| fig-width: 7

dat |>

    labels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Journal quartile", y = "Percentage", fill = NULL)
```
